name: Cold Start
hint: One take, no Echo — nothing here needs one. Run right along the floor (top y=20, you stand at y=18.45). Jump the first floor break at x=12..16.6 (4.6 units) without stopping at the lip, land on the middle slab, jump the second break at x=25.6..30.2 (also 4.6), then hop the 2.8-unit step onto the ledge whose left edge is x=34.5 (top y=17.2) and walk into the exit at x=36.6. Every jump is inside budget: 4.6 across vs 6.0 allowed, 2.8 up vs 3.4 allowed. Missing the ledge drops you back onto the floor that runs underneath it, so the step is safe to retry.

dialogue.text: Sector one. Life support is holding. Nothing else is.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Get up. There are two breaks in the floor between you and the door.
Don't slow down at the edges. The gap is shorter than the run-up.
